New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-link-save-and-reuse-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-link-save-and-reuse-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-link-save-and-reuse.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/save-and-reuse`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/save-and-reuse, the November capture documents server creation of a SetupIntent bound to a customer-configured Accounts v2 Account (`customer_account`) or a Customers v1 Customer (`customer`). Connect users are described as generally eligible for Accounts v2, while other Stripe users are in public preview and preview participants must specify a preview version. The merchant passes the SetupIntent client secret to Elements and the browser calls `stripe.confirmSetup` with a return URL. Link authenticates or enrolls by email, either passed to the Payment Element, collected in that Element with Link enabled in settings, or collected via Contact Details Element before optional Address and Payment Elements. A matching existing Link account triggers a phone code and successful authentication permits autofill. Live pages use HTTPS, with a testing exception. The server later lists `type=link` methods for the corresponding identity, selects a PaymentMethod and creates a separate PaymentIntent with amount, currency, `confirm=true` and `off_session=true`, which can error if authentication is required. Setup and return URL handling do not prove a later payment. The May capture documents the same lifecycle, but uses Link Authentication Element in the separate-email flow and explicit card/Link SetupIntent examples. See old raw lines 32-123, old raw lines 192-241, old raw lines 1039-1220, new raw lines 40-125, new raw lines 170-238, new raw lines 369-373, new raw lines 479-503 and new raw lines 1017-1175. source-stripe-link-save-and-reuse.md lines 13-45 summarize the May flow and need the November implementation and dated qualifications. Its 'Accounts v2 No' counterpart entry also contradicts the counterpart's already-documented May optional saving path.
reviewed_answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/link/save-and-reuse, source-stripe-link-save-and-reuse.md needs substantive documented updates for the third email strategy (May Link Authentication Element to November Contact Details Element and its component identifiers), both SetupIntent examples (explicit card/Link to automatic payment methods), and Accounts v2 preview enrollment instructions and the shown Account-create header. The SetupIntent client-secret gloss now correctly refers to setup despite retained PaymentIntent reference links. Node versus Ruby/cURL sample presentation, styling, CDN assets, text diagrams and See also routing do not establish behavior. Dahlia versus Endive is a dated script-example change. Preserve May 8, 2026 provenance, the old LAE and explicit listing examples, and historical domain and funding/guarantee wording. November drops the explicit domain sentence and exclusivity and changes guarantees language to processing behavior; separate November domain registration guidance still names Link in Elements, and the two wordings do not establish changed eligibility or financial terms. The Stripe Link reciprocal route needs the Contact Details versus retained LinkAuthenticationElement React confirmSetup example warning, and the source needs the already false PaymentIntent counterpart Accounts v2 exclusion corrected for its optional save/reuse path. Later PaymentIntent confirmation can encounter an off-session auth error. Browser return, sandbox 3DS and passcode results are limited to their stated contexts and do not verify a live charge, settlement or compliance. See old raw lines 32-123, old raw lines 307-318, old raw lines 482-502, old raw lines 1039-1106, old raw lines 1222-1257, new raw lines 40-125, new raw lines 308-317, new raw lines 479-503, new raw lines 1017-1175 and new raw lines 1177-1218.
